mentions.name: TownWire
mentions.description: This platform creates online business directories for small cities, launching location-specific directory sites that list and promote local businesses. Its first location site has launched and emphasizes keeping commerce personal and community-driven.
mentions.problem: With the current tech climate of AI and big tech, things have gotten impersonal for the majority of actual people.
mentions.audience: Residents of small cities and the small businesses that serve those communities
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a platform for small-city business directories called TownWire: https://townwire.com

We launched our first location last week and have had a great response so far from business owners and residents alike: https://canandaigua.com
